correctness.rationale: Each coupon arrival stream is an independent rate-one Poisson process. Given the maximum first-arrival time t and the last type, the remaining singleton indicators are independent Bernoulli with exact probability t/(exp(t)-1). The centered conditional characteristic function has a uniform compact Gumbel-offset Gaussian limit at variance exp(-g), establishing a joint mixed-normal limit. Independent Exp(n) interarrival times yield E(W_n-T_n/n)^2=H_n/n; multiplying the error by log n still tends to zero in L2, so the observable random center is legitimate. The Gaussian pivot follows by continuous mapping, with exp(-G)>0. Exact finite-state rational verification for sizes 2 through 14 checks the supporting moment calculations but is not offered as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The full discrete joint distribution of T_n and S_n is ALREADY published by Myers--Wilf (2003), and the first-order exponential limit of S_n/log n is ALREADY published in Ilienko (2020 preprint). These are not claimed. The current claim isolates residual sqrt(log n)-scale Gaussian fluctuations after subtracting the actual observed Gumbel-time-dependent center, and establishes the asymptotic independence of the resulting observable Gaussian pivot and the Gumbel time. The inspected stronger finite joint PMF, first-order point-process theorem, and deterministic-time multivariate CLTs do not state or immediately supply that random-centered second-order CLT; it requires a separate conditional-binomial expansion and fine depoissonization. The exact finite covariance is treated only as context. Historical priority remains an explicit risk.
residual_risks: The fully explicit Myers--Wilf finite joint PMF can potentially yield an already-known conditional second-order theorem under another formulation.
A general occupancy conditional CLT or a supplement to an early coupon-brotherhood study not located could imply this precise statement.
No quantitative convergence rate or external independent mathematical review is claimed.

value.rationale: The first-order exponential singleton fluctuation at coupon collection is known; a random-centered square-root-log Gaussian residual is a natural, unreported second-order invariant of the same stopping experiment. Its conditional variance depends nontrivially on the observed Gumbel completion offset. The resulting entirely observable pivot is asymptotically independent of the completion extreme, a substantive refinement for occupancy model diagnostics, not merely a finite table or parameter substitution.
